{"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolled out on 2026-01-15, sends txn_ts in UTC, while the legacy collector sends America/Chicago local time. silver_transactions casts both the same way, so v2 evening transactions land 6 hours late: they show up between 00:00 and 06:00 and some roll over into the next day, which is why 2026-01-19 has only 36 rows and they are all v2. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time with a fixed 6-hour offset; that is correct for this January data (CST is UTC-6, no DST change), but it must move to a real time zone conversion before DST starts on 2026-03-08.",
 "decision": "fix",
 "confidence": 0.85,
 "pre_sql": [],
 "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
